invented.quote: For most of that time Tomás has run our 3 a.m. milking shift alone, five days a week.
invented.why: The brief states that he runs the 3 a.m. shift, not that he has done so for most of his three years at the farm.

invented.quote: He taught himself our herd management software [name, if desired] and now uses it to spot cows that need the vet's attention.
invented.why: The brief says he learned the software, not that he taught himself.

invented.quote: He did it because he was paying attention to the data and to the animals, not because anyone told him to.
invented.why: The brief does not state that flagging sick cows was done without anyone telling him to do it.

invented.quote: That count does not include five weeks of leave last summer, when he returned to Mexico because his father was seriously ill.
invented.why: The brief states only that his father got sick in Mexico, not that Tomás was returning to his home country or that the illness was serious.

invented.quote: His spoken English is strong, and he communicates well with the crew, our vet and me.
invented.why: The brief only says his written English is weaker than his spoken English, not that his spoken English is strong or that he communicates well with the crew, vet, and manager.

invented.quote: He is taking a night class to improve it, on his own initiative and around a demanding work schedule.
invented.why: The brief states he is taking a night class, not that he is doing so on his own initiative.
